input.prompt: Create ONE 2K square photorealistic editorial macro product image by faithfully enhancing the attached CROPPED PRODUCT REFERENCE. Keep the same camera position, crop, proportions and all existing product pixels' visual geometry. Only refine soft warm-neutral lighting and fine photographic clarity. Do not redesign, expand the crop, zoom out, orbit, reconstruct hidden surfaces or recompose the product. Maintain natural dark chocolate leather, its observed fine grain, smoother warmer brown trim, brown thread, soft folds and subtle satin sheen. Neutral atelier mood with soft side light and realistic restrained gold reflections; no orange filter or plastic CGI shine. This close-up is about the actual narrow rounded BRAID in this crop. Keep its three-strand plait, strand direction and width EXACTLY. It is a narrow intertwined leather braid with diagonal loops; it is NOT a broad flat woven checkerboard ribbon. Keep the neighboring smooth brown panel, tiny tonal stitches and existing handle tube at the same positions. Preserve all existing details including the visible fold/cutout, and show no new part of the bag. No hands, tools, workshop scene, text, logo, diagram, measurement, certification, new interior, backside, canvas, suede, white contrast stitches or new hardware. The output must look like a faithful sharper photograph of this SAME cropped region.
